implementation.likes: Anonymous browser identity; reversible atomic count and private per-UID vote. Duplicate increments, forged counts and cross-user vote reads denied. Clearing browser storage or another browser can create another identity; this is not verified-person voting.
implementation.comments: Public display collection contains only poemId, name, message and publishedAt. Pending submissions and UID remain private. Display uses textContent, never comment HTML. Names <=80; text <=2000; per-UID 60-second submission interval; paginated public reads <=20.
implementation.reader_ui: Reader responses beneath poem: Like and Comments disclosure, public-name field, text, explicit publication consent and private-editor link. New controls remain hidden while runtime flags are off.
implementation.firebase_features: Existing Spark Firestore and anonymous Auth. New composite index for poemId plus publishedAt. No Functions, billing upgrade or public reader sign-in.
limitations: Anonymous UID throttles are not global abuse protection; App Check is not configured.
Owner moderation uses Firebase Console. No editor dashboard or new staff account access is provisioned.
Rules, indexes and live integrations are not yet deployed or production-tested.

moderation_runbook: Open the kabita-live Firestore Console and review commentSubmissions documents with status pending.

To approve, create a publicComments document using the SAME document ID. Copy only poemId (string), name (string) and message (string); add publishedAt (timestamp, current time). Do not copy uid, consentVersion or private fields. This console action publishes the comment.
Mark the source commentSubmissions status published. To reject, keep it out of publicComments and mark rejected.
To withdraw an approved comment, delete its exact publicComments document and mark the private source rejected. Do not delete other reader records.
Review and clear obsolete rejected/test records manually; no automatic retention job is configured.
